description: Sling parent POM enforcer rules silently broken with enforcer < 3.2.1

Sling parent POM uses maven-antrun-plugin with JavaScript (Nashorn engine) for set-bundle-required-execution-environment — Nashorn was removed in JDK 15. These projects need JDK ≤ 14 to build, or the antrun execution needs to be rewritten.
errorPatterns: Unable to create javax script engine for javascript

description: maven-bundle-plugin hits ConcurrentModificationException under Maven 4 — likely due to concurrent access to project dependency collections with Maven 4's parallel-capable model
Project's parent.relativePath points to a sibling repository (e.g. ../../parent, ../brooklyn-server) that isn't checked out — multi-repo project layout that can't be tested standalone
maven-enforcer-plugin < 3.0.0 uses removed PluginParameterExpressionEvaluator constructor
Old Quarkus/plugin versions use ServiceLocator pattern removed in Maven 4
Project depends on SNAPSHOT artifacts not available in release repositories
commons-release-plugin clean-staging fails under Maven 4 — commons-ognl is dormant
jax-maven-plugin 0.1.8 NPE under Maven 4 — plugin unmaintained, oozie is retired
maven-compiler-plugin < 3.11 cannot find ErrorProne plug-in under Maven 4 classloading

TransitiveDependencyManager applies dependencyManagement at all depths, which can downgrade transitive dependency versions and trigger enforcer violations — this is intended Maven 4 behavior, projects need to add explicit dependencyManagement
hadoop-project 3.1.0, 3.2.0-3.2.2 and 3.3.0 have invalid XML (<Xlint:-unchecked/>) causing Non-parseable POM errors in Maven 4, losing transitive deps
Maven 4 no longer interpolates properties in <module> paths at POM reading time — projects using ${spark.version} or similar in module names fail
Quarkus plugin (especially < 3.20) uses ServiceLocator/RepositorySystem patterns incompatible with Maven 4's Sisu-based DI
SNAPSHOT artifacts marked as 'present, but unavailable' under Maven 4's resolver — different metadata handling
Maven 4's prefix-based repository routing blocks artifacts not matching /.meta/prefixes.txt — artifacts available in Maven 3 become unfindable
Tycho < 5.0 uses Guice/Sisu injection patterns broken by Maven 4's classloading — upgrade to Tycho 5.0.3+
Maven 4 classloading changes cause 'foreign imports' errors in plugins that rely on Maven 3's classrealm layout (Quarkus, JAXB, etc.)

Maven 4's TransitiveDependencyManager changes transitive dependency resolution, causing previously available dependencies to disappear from the classpath — projects need to add explicit dependency declarations
Maven 4's TransitiveDependencyManager changes cause 'cannot find symbol' compilation errors — transitive dependencies no longer on classpath
Maven 4's TransitiveDependencyManager changes cause Scala compilation errors — transitive dependencies (javax.annotation, etc.) no longer on classpath
errorPatterns: is not a member of package

description: Maven 4's different dependency resolution brings in new transitive deps not listed in the project's license MISSING.properties file, causing license-maven-plugin to fail
Karaf feature verification fails under Maven 4 due to OSGi bundle version mismatches from changed transitive dependency resolution
Projects using ${revision} CI-friendly versions without flatten-maven-plugin have missing dependency versions under Maven 4's stricter validation
maven-site-plugin Velocity template rendering fails under Maven 4 — incompatible site plugin version
Maven 4 rejects dependency resolution when transitive dependencies have uninterpolated ${...} version expressions, causing 'Invalid Collect Request: null'
Maven 4's stricter POM validation rejects uninterpolated ${...} expressions in repository URLs, distribution management IDs, and other POM fields that Maven 3 silently accepted
maven-shade-plugin's dependency-reduced-pom.xml causes 'The parents form a cycle' error in Maven 4's stricter model builder
Maven 4's stricter XML parser rejects transitive POMs with invalid XML (illegal processing instructions, undeclared namespace prefixes) that Maven 3 tolerated
cyclonedx-maven-plugin fails with 'Invalid Version Range Request' when project uses ${revision} CI-friendly versions
Develocity Maven extension fails to initialize under Maven 4 due to SLF4J classloading changes — ClassNotFoundException: org.slf4j.impl.SimpleLogger
spotless-maven-plugin format check fails because mvnup POM modifications change formatting that spotless enforces
sortpom-maven-plugin verify fails because mvnup POM modifications change the order/content that sortpom enforces
Maven 4's stricter POM parser rejects duplicate XML elements (artifactId, properties, etc.) that Maven 3 silently accepted — project POMs need to be fixed
Maven 4's stricter POM validation rejects duplicate dependency declarations (same groupId:artifactId) that Maven 3 silently merged
Ancient org.scala-tools:maven-scala-plugin (unmaintained since 2011) calls add() on immutable lists returned by Maven 4 API — projects should migrate to net.alchim31.maven:scala-maven-plugin
pgpverify-maven-plugin < 1.20 hits ClassCastException with Maven 4's resolver re-entrancy marker in RequestTrace — resolver regression being tracked
Maven 4's model builder reorders POM elements into a canonical order that differs from source, breaking enforcer rules that check element ordering

Projects with multiple maven-jar-plugin executions producing the same unclassified artifact (e.g. prepare-jar + default-jar) fail after mvnup upgrades from 2.x to 3.x+ — the projectHasAlreadySetAnArtifact() check added in 3.0.0 rejects the second execution. This is a project-side issue, not a Maven 4 bug.

Projects using -Werror with -source 8 fail because javac emits 'bootstrap class path not set in conjunction with -source 8' warning when cross-compiling without a bootclasspath — project-side issue, not Maven 4 specific

Maven plugin projects fail to compile against Maven 4 API — MojoExecutionException not resolved as subclass of Throwable due to changed API jar structure. Project-side issue, closed as not planned (apache/maven#12990).
errorPatterns: must be a subclass of Throwable

description: blueprint-maven-plugin:1.10.0 uses xbean-asm5 which cannot read JDK 17+ class files (ASM 5 max = Java 8). Unmaintained since 2018, no Maven 4-compatible version exists.
cxf-xjc-plugin < 4.1.1 is not Maven 4 compatible (CXFXJC-46) — JAXB code generation fails, causing missing generated types at compile time
Dependencies using ${javacpp.platform} as classifier require the javacpp profile to be activated — the property is set by OS detection in javacpp's POM, and may not resolve correctly in Maven 4

maven-jar-plugin >= 3.3.0 (archiver >= 3.6.0) validates that project.build.outputTimestamp ISO-8601 strings are within 1980-2099. Projects using '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z' or other pre-1980 ISO dates fail after mvnup upgrades jar-plugin. Will be fixed in next maven-jar-plugin release (archiver will clamp instead of throwing).
errorPatterns: is not within the valid range 1980-01-01T00:00:02Z

description: maven-jar-plugin >= 3.3.0 (archiver >= 3.3.0) validates Automatic-Module-Name manifest entries. Projects using ${project.groupId}.${project.artifactId} as module name fail when artifactId contains hyphens (invalid JPMS module name). Will be fixed in next maven-jar-plugin release (archiver will warn and remove the attribute instead of throwing).

exec-maven-plugin <= 3.1.0 calls session.getContainer().lookup(ToolchainManager.ROLE) in ExecMojo.getToolchain() — MavenSession.getContainer() returns null in Maven 4. Fixed in exec-maven-plugin 3.2.0. mvnup upgrades exec but the version may be locked by a property in a parent POM.

org.apache.hyracks:license-automation-plugin uses maven-compat DefaultModelInheritanceAssembler which throws UnsupportedOperationException in Maven 4 (all methods stubbed). The plugin needs to be updated.

Apache Taverna projects use APIs that are incompatible with JDK 17: override conflicts with javax.swing (JDK changes), ambiguous FileSystem.newFileSystem overloads (JDK 13 added new overloads), and old XSD plugin failures. These are old archived projects.

Project declares a system dependency on jdk.tools:jdk.tools:jar:1.6 pointing to tools.jar at /usr/lib/jvm/..., which does not exist in JDK 9+ (tools.jar was removed). Maven 4 fails to resolve the system dependency path.
karaf-reactive-components depends on biz.aQute.bnd:bnd-shared-maven-lib:5.1.0 which is not available in Maven Central (artifact was removed/relocated). Build fails at dependency resolution.

mvnup modifications to pom.xml files trigger Apache RAT license checks that report new/modified files as having unapproved licenses. The build skips rat with -Drat.skip=true but some projects use custom RAT execution IDs or have non-standard configurations.
errorPatterns: Too many files with unapproved license

description: org.apache.karaf.tooling:karaf-services-maven-plugin:4.2.8 was compiled with JDK 17 (class file version 61) but is loaded in an environment where the plugin classloader rejects it. Plugin is too old for the current JDK.
Scala code generation (via scalac) fails with 'Error while emitting' on JDK 17+ with certain Scala versions. The Scala compiler version used by the project is not compatible with JDK 17.
Scala compilation fails with 'ambiguous reference to overloaded definition' — JDK added new overloads (e.g. in Spark/Hadoop APIs) that conflict with existing Scala usage patterns.
